assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate these symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities.
The procedure addresses the reported palpitations and irregular heartbeat sensation (R00.2).
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
This diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's cardiac conduction abnormalities given the documented symptoms and known mitral valve insufficiency.
